  "body": "h1. notifier runbook

Owned by team platform (grace, heidi). Alerts go to #platform-alerts; incidents are discussed in #incidents.

h2. Known failure modes

h3. TemplateNotFound
Symptom: log lines containing 'TemplateNotFound: no template registered for event' from render().
Check: error rate panel for service=notifier; search logs for the trace_id in the alert.
Remediation: roll back the latest deploy of notifier; if persists, page platform on-call.

h3. RateLimited
Symptom: log lines containing 'RateLimited: downstream SMS provider rate limited' from send_sms().
Check: error rate panel for service=notifier; search logs for the trace_id in the alert.
Remediation: roll back the latest deploy of notifier; if persists, page platform on-call.

h2. Dashboards
Chronosphere: rate(http_requests_total{service="notifier",code=~"5.."}[5m])
"
